name: wowcube
description: WowCube game development skills for OctaviOS (octavios dev 2026-10-21 or later): cube_orchestrator (single entry point; autonomous runs with one style-approval stop, a mandatory check of every build on hidden 24-screen simulator frames, a verified device .oct and upload to the cube on request), cube_game-designer (GDD with game-feel checks), technical_prompter (implementation prompts with test hooks + the asset manifest), cube_art-director (style-locked Codex art on the ChatGPT subscription with strict QA; also standalone for artists), cube_asset-builder (art, CC0 sound via sound_kit, launcher icon and fonts -> packed app assets), wowcube-boilerplate (scaffold in the dev layout, simulator builds, device .oct via octpack-build), cube_verifier (Requirements, Template and Playtest agents), wowcube-html-prototype (optional browser prototype of the mechanic) and wowcube-demo-video (standard-format demo videos), the last two by Alex Poshivalov.
